product.title: Matcha Experience with of Japanese Tea Tasting in Tokyo

description.text: In Tokyo, this 90-minute tasting sits in Asakusa Tawaramachi with a former tea farmer who covers cultivation, processing, and a matcha ceremony. Five Japanese teas, including matcha and sencha, plus snacks are listed, and the group is capped at five. The meeting point is the second floor of Henn na Hotel Tokyo Asakusa Tawaramachi in Kotobuki, Taito City. The session stays on tasting and ceremony instruction rather than a temple-hopping walk. The format suits visitors who want a guided tea window without booking a full cultural workshop independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Tokyo, and the itinerary stays on Asakusa and the matcha ceremony that define this tasting rather than a sake-brewery transfer.

highlights: Guided tasting of five Japanese teas including matcha
Matcha ceremony instruction from a former tea farmer
